package answer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// AnswerDetails aggregates answer with review data.
type AnswerDetails struct {
	Answer       domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	AutoReview   *domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview
	ManualReview *domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview
}

// GetStudentAnswer loads answer and review results.
type GetStudentAnswer struct {
	Answers       repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	AutoReviews   repository.AutoReviewRepository
	ManualReviews repository.ManualReviewRepository
}

// Handle returns answer details by id.
func (uc GetStudentAnswer) Handle(ctx context.Context, answerID string) (*AnswerDetails, error) {
	answer, err := uc.Answers.GetByID(ctx, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	details := &AnswerDetails{Answer: *answer}
	if ar, err := uc.AutoReviews.GetByAnswerID(ctx, answerID); err == nil {
		details.AutoReview = ar
	} else if err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}
	if mr, err := uc.ManualReviews.GetByAnswerID(ctx, answerID); err == nil {
		details.ManualReview = mr
	} else if err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}
	return details, nil
}
